contexts.text: Then shall all the tribes of the earth wail () = that all who are in the good of love and truth of faith will be in grief. ( = a lack of all truth of faith and good of love. DSS 14:2.) BE 73.
There shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth () = their state in the other life; wailing = their state as to evils.
Wailing and weeping over the dead, in the Ancient Churches, = interior mourning. Illustrated.

They wailed there an exceedingly great and grievous wailing () = grief... here, the grief of initiation... for before the Knowledges of good and truth... can be implanted in good... there is grief. (Explained.)
All the tribes of the earth shall wail () = that this will be when there are no longer any goods and truths in the Church. ( = that the falsities of the Church will oppose. Explained. AE 39.)
They shall weep and wail () = their interior griefs. (To weep = mourning because of falsities; and to wail = mourning because of evils. Illustrated. AE 1129:2.)
Lamentation over the destruction of good, is signified by wailing ().
Mourning on this account (is signified by) wail and howl ().
Wail over the multitude of Egypt () = grief on account of their damnation.
They shall not be bewailed... () = no restoration... Bewailing = grief on account of such a state of man; and no bewailing = no grief because the man is such that there can be no restoration.

Over this I will wail and howl () = the grief of the Angels... and of the men of the Church... with whom the Lord is. ( = lamentation over this Church; lamentation over devastated good is signified by I will make a wailing like dragons ()... AE 714:20.)
